title.rendered: ntop User’s Group Meeting at Shakfest EU 2017

content.rendered:
Those who have not been able to attend our ntop meeting at Sharkfest Europe 2017 can find our presentation slides below

  • Sharkfest EU 2017 – Intro
  • Sharkfest EU 2017 – hardware-flow-offload
  • Sharkfest EU 2017 – beautiful monitoring with ntopng and grafana
  • Sharkfest EU 2017 – microprobes
  • Sharkfest EU 2017 – extcap, remote wireshark and demo
  • Sharkfest EU 2017 – EdgeTrafficMonitoring
  • Sharkfest EU 2017 – what’s new, new products and roadmap

We need your feedback and we could be glad if our community could give us guidance in the next steps. So please don’t be shy and send us a mail about 2018 plans. Thank you!
